manifest_row.notes: Operator assembly, review-grade, never certified. The 17 lineups are exactly the thesis-ladder rows of build sd_87f55d515c4c (v2: supplied SP Base Snell 15.9 = APPG x0.85, Gasser 11.0 = APPG x0.80 for postseason hooks, sha256 386d2d24; platoon splits blended 50/50 toward overall OPS for bullpen PA, sha256 of file in brief; odds cbs+si paste). Two row swaps, no lineup changed: Solo Shot 5295564042 takes the Snell-CPT LAD-close lineup from $100 Dime Time 5295556044, which takes the Smith-CPT bottom-order lineup; Daily Dollar SE 5295563799 takes the Betts-CPT LAD-close lineup from $300 Dime Time 5295564564, which takes the Pratt-CPT bottom-order lineup. The ladder deals templates by file position, so both single-entry contests had drawn leverage templates and both $300 Dime Time entries were LAD 4-2 builds.

prediction_source.ceiling_basis: null on every Showdown entry: the melted and priced frames carry Base and no Ceiling column on either path (the thesis ladder or the points-max bank), so there is no ceiling sum to record
prediction_source.label: what the Showdown build predicted for each lineup it chose, handed to the record in process at delivery because a Showdown build has no run folder: the thesis template (or points_max for the baseline and the points-max bank), the realized captain and whether it is a pitcher or a hitter, the team split, the Base sum with the captain at 1.5x and its rank in the build, and the labeled captain-slot and six-slot roster priors or null. build_id is one per build's inputs (date, slate tag, salary and template bytes): the baseline and the ladder of a build share it, and two builds over the same inputs share it too, told apart by their sha256 and recorded_utc. Deterministic review proxies and labeled priors, never ROI, a win rate or a probability
prediction_source.rank_basis: rank_in_build orders this build's own lineups by base_sum descending, ties by slot; slot is the lineup's 1-based place in the build (the ladder's deal order or the bank's solve order), which is the order of the reserved rows it filled
